note: Kokoro v1.0's own overall grade for each voice (VOICES.md of the model's release: 'estimates of the quality and quantity of its associated training data, both of which impact overall inference quality'). English voices only: the grades of the other languages rate those languages, not English read by them. The casting's rule (test/voice-casting.test.js): every character's dominant component is an English voice graded C or better, unless the owner chose the voice by ear.
